: Provenance: HAND-AUTHORED under SMA-840 (PR #387), not captured from the
: wire. It has a thinking block with no signature_delta. The probe saw exactly
: one signature_delta in each thinking block (the SMA-840 design,
: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-sma-840-anthropic-thinking-signatures-design.md,
: lines 42-44). So no capture has this shape.
:
: Sources of the shapes. The SMA-840 plan describes only the shape
: (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-21-sma-840-anthropic-thinking-signatures.md,
: lines 185-186). It does not name a source.
:
: - message_start, message_delta and message_stop: these three data lines are
:   byte-identical to the ones in thinking_text_tool_use.txt (run C). So the
:   id, the model and the usage counts belong to that capture, not to the
:   content of this file. The plan does not say this. The bytes show it.
: - Thinking block: the event shapes of thinking_text_tool_use.txt, with no
:   signature_delta. The texts "Thinking with" and " no signature." have no
:   recorded source.
: - tool_use block: the event shapes of thinking_text_tool_use.txt, with
:   caller. The id toolu_fake_c has no recorded source. The tool name comes
:   from the probe script
:   (docs/superpowers/probes/2026-11-21-sma-840-anthropic-thinking-probe.sh,
:   line 33).
: - Tool input fragments: "", then {"city": and "Paris"}. The capture splits
:   its input at other places. The record does not give a source for this
:   split.
: - No ping event. The captures send one after the first content_block_start.
:   The record does not say why this file has none.
